tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task generate:check
tasks.coverage: deno coverage --exclude='\.spec\.ts$' --exclude='/generated/' --exclude='/generate-api\.ts$' --lcov --output=coverage/lcov.info coverage/raw && deno coverage --exclude='\.spec\.ts$' --exclude='/generated/' --exclude='/generate-api\.ts$' coverage/raw
tasks.generate:check: deno task generate:api && deno fmt runtime/generated && git diff --exit-code -- runtime/generated
tasks.test:coverage: deno task test --coverage=coverage/raw && deno task coverage
